lines.text: Many learners say: He is very sensible.
Sensible means full of good sense.

data.why: Sensible means full of good sense.

quiz.stem: She cries easily. She is very ___.

native.caption: Ist jemand sensibel? Dann nicht „sensible“! 💔 Falsch: “He is very sensible.” Richtig: “He is very sensitive.” Hör Carlos zu und sprich nach! Mehr üben in der Lexkite-App.
native.comment: Lösung: “sensitive”. Richtig heißt es: “He is very sensitive.” Übe mehr mit einem kostenlosen Quiz: {link}

en.caption: Is someone sensibel? Then not “sensible”! Wrong: “He is very sensible.” Right: “He is very sensitive.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
